podcast.body: This song was the winner of the 2000 Billboard Song of the Summer. It is described as a "fairly forgettable rocker" that benefited from lead singer Rob Thomas's higher profile after he co-wrote and sang the Santana smash "Smooth." "This song is no smooth, but somehow Matchbox 20's Bent was the song of summer for 2000."
